howBytesWereMeasured.pixels: pdftoppm -r 300 -gray writing P5 PGM DIRECTLY, one page at a time, each render deleted as soon as it was measured because this container had about 2.5 GB free. -gray -png was never used: an RGB PNG is misread silently by a naive grayscale reader. The P5 reader was written for this lane and REFUSES any file whose magic is not P5 and whose maxval is not 255, so a format substitution cannot pass unnoticed. Ink is grey < 200. The pinned source is rendered WITH annotations (pdftoppm's default; -hide-annotations was not used).
howBytesWereMeasured.differential: added = pixels that are ink in the delivered page and not ink in the paired source page; lost = ink in the source and not in the delivered page. Computed with numpy boolean masks over the full 2550x3300 raster.
howBytesWereMeasured.rectBracketing: PUBLISHED IN BOTH CONVENTIONS where it could matter. floor on the low edge and ceil on the high edge, and separately rounded on both. The two agree on every figure quoted in this return. On MI pages 2 and 3 the floor/ceil box reaches one raster row further and picks up 429 px of the printed rule and caption at the boundary, while the rounded box contains 0 px of printed source ink; the ADDED-ink figures are identical under both (2,947 and 2,599), which is itself the proof that the drawn glyphs do not touch the printed label.
howBytesWereMeasured.widgetRectangles: Read first-hand from each pinned binary with pdf-lib -- getForm().getFields(), acroField.getWidgets(), and a direct walk of each page's /Annots array filtering /Subtype /Widget -- never taken from the family's own map.
howBytesWereMeasured.printedTextAtCoordinates: pdftotext -bbox on the pinned binary and on the delivered fixtures, word boxes converted from top-left to PDF space by pageHeight - yMax .. pageHeight - yMin.
howBytesWereMeasured.verbatimDisclosure: A line-anchored matcher written in Python for this lane: a record string counts as line-anchored only when some single line of the delivered file, after stripping a leading list marker or ordinal and bold emphasis, equals it exactly, or ends with it exactly after a bold label prefix of at most 20 characters. Substring presence is reported separately.
howBytesWereMeasured.digests: sha256sum for every file; Node crypto inside the builders' own self-checks.
